name: krouter
description: Your AI remembers what you decided, and what you changed your mind about, from a folder of plain Markdown on this machine.
long_description: Ask what you decided and the answer comes with the page it came from; a correction replaces the old answer; when the memory does not know, Claude is told so instead of being handed a guess. Lookups run on this machine with no model and no network. The memory folder is plain Markdown: open it in any editor, or in Obsidian. Needs Python 3.9 or newer.

tools.name: krouter_ask
tools.description: Look a question up in the memory: the answer, the page it came from, or 'not in the memory'.

tools.name: krouter_status
tools.description: Health of the memory folder and what, if anything, needs doing.

tools.name: krouter_note
tools.description: Write one line down (a decision, a correction, a fact) as a clue on today's notes page.

memory_folder.title: Memory folder
memory_folder.description: The KRouter memory folder (plain Markdown). Leave empty to use the one the KRouter install recorded.
